name: Nartaris
source:
Nartaris – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A young blue yellow-eyed om'verai with a white half-mask, with white belly spikes and 2 head horns.
A trusting easy-going young om'verai, interested in creating and listening to music.
